Backend 3/3 passed: friends-nearby with offer object (demo sees Karak Cafe item with offer.label='50% off Karak'); freeuser empty-safe {items:[]}; 100% BigPoints scan-to-pay regression (resolve→quote→authorize→capture, card_cents=0 no Stripe, receipt subtotal=500/charge=0/points_used=500). Mobile pay-checkout: after 100% BigPoints pay (points-500 pill → pay-submit-btn), pay-receipt-title 'Payment Successful!' renders with Subtotal AED 5.00 / BigCoin used -500 BC / Total paid AED 0.00 (no NaN); pay-share-btn 'Share receipt' renders ABOVE pay-done-btn (share y=407, done y=473); tapping pay-share-btn does NOT crash (Share.share throws on web → caught by try/catch and shows Alert, receipt still visible). action_items: None blocking. (Nice-to-have, not a bug) The 'new activity' pill test could not be deterministically triggered from the harness — producing a fresh following-feed item requires another followed user/station to post within the 25s poll window. The code path (useEffect @ home.tsx:129, pendingFeed state + newPostCount derivation + revealNewPosts) is correctly wired against /api/social/feed-v2?mode=following; absence at idle is correct behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/social_v2.py:980-997 — offers_by_biz lookup is efficient (single $in query, dict dedupe), filters on status='active' AND (expires_at is null OR >now). Label fallback chain (discount_label → discount_percent → discount_value_pct → 'Special offer') is correct. offer_id falls back to str(_id) if offer_id missing — safe.

mobile/app/(tabs)/home.tsx:129-148 — 25s setInterval polls both /social/feed-v2 (following) and /social/friends-nearby, cleans up on unmount. Pending-feed staging uses id-set diff so only NEW items trigger the pill (home.tsx:139-140). revealNewPosts correctly swaps feed+feedRef and clears pending. Non-crashing when pending empty (newPostCount computes 0, pill condition hides it).

mobile/app/(tabs)/home.tsx:332-357 — Nearby card wraps the whole Pressable (correct touch target); gold deal pill is a child View (not a nested Pressable → tap bubbles to the parent routing to /store/<biz_id>). testID home-nearby-{i}-deal is on the deal container (correct).

mobile/app/pay-checkout/[token].tsx:101-113 — shareReceipt uses RN Share.share with a compiled message including merchant name, paid, points used, points earned; wraps in try/catch and surfaces errors via Alert.alert. On web preview, Share.share rejects silently or throws — caught cleanly, receipt remains visible (verified).

mobile/app/pay-checkout/[token].tsx:154-158 — share button uses TouchableOpacity with 44pt target, Ionicons share-social, testID pay-share-btn, positioned between the earnedCard and the Done button → matches spec of 'above Done'.

Minor non-blocking: expo-notifications web warning ('Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web') is informational, not a deprecation (expo-notifications is NOT on the deprecated list in Expo Related Pointers). Can ignore for now.
